# UK property fixtures (HMRC's own examples)

Copied unchanged from HMRC's published API definitions on GitHub, checked 28 Oct 2026:

| File | Source |
| --- | --- |
| `uk_cumulative_6.0_request.json` | github.com/hmrc/property-business-api `resources/public/api/conf/6.0/examples/uk_property_cumulative_summary_create_and_amend/def1/request.json` (commit e57db0b, 20 Oct 2026) |
| `uk_cumulative_6.0_consolidated_request.json` | the same folder, `consolidated_request.json` |
| `test_support_1.0_create_business_uk_property.json` | github.com/hmrc/mtd-sa-test-support-api `resources/public/api/conf/1.0/examples/businesses/create_request_uk_property.json` |

These are the same files developer.service.hmrc.gov.uk renders as the Property Business (MTD) 6.0 and Self
Assessment Test Support 1.0 documentation. They are example bodies, not recordings of a real sandbox call.
